LONDON, GREATER LONDON, UNITED KINGDOM, October 26, 2026 /EINPresswire.com/ -- The artificial intelligence (AI) sector within self-driving cars is rapidly transforming the future of transportation, promising safer roads and smarter mobility. As autonomous technology advances, the AI component in self-driving vehicles is becoming central to innovations shaping the automotive landscape. Let’s explore the current scale, key drivers, leading players, and growth opportunities in this dynamic market.

Projected Market Size and Role of AI in Self-Driving Cars The AI market specifically tailored for self-driving cars is set to surpass $49 billion by 2030. When compared to its broader parent market—the Autonomous Vehicle market—that is forecasted to reach about $275 billion in the same year, AI in self-driving cars will account for approximately 18% of that total. Looking at the wider Transport industry, expected to swell to $9,400 billion by 2030, the AI segment in autonomous vehicles will represent nearly 1% of the entire market value, highlighting its growing strategic importance.

North America’s Leading Position in AI-Driven Self-Driving Cars By 2030, North America is anticipated to lead the AI in self-driving cars market, with a projected value of $16.9 billion. Starting from $2.1 billion in 2025, this market is expected to grow at an impressive compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 52%. This rapid expansion is fueled by substantial investments in autonomous vehicle testing and deployment, breakthroughs in AI-driven perception and decision-making technologies, advancements in high-definition mapping and sensor fusion, favorable government regulations supporting autonomous vehicle pilots, and the strong presence of major automotive manufacturers, technology firms, and startups across the USA and Canada.

Dominance of the USA Within the Global Market The United States will stand out as the largest single country market in AI for self-driving cars by 2030, valued at $14.8 billion. Growth from $1.8 billion in 2025 to this level is supported by a 52% CAGR. Key factors behind this surge include extensive deployment of autonomous pilot programs in major metropolitan areas, increased integration of AI-based driver assistance technologies in both passenger and commercial vehicles, heavy investments in cutting-edge semiconductor and edge computing for real-time intelligence, expansion of infrastructure dedicated to connected and autonomous vehicle testing, and strong collaboration among automotive manufacturers, tech companies, and mobility platforms nationwide.

Software Segment to Capture the Largest Share by 2030 Breaking down the AI in self-driving cars market by component reveals that software will be the leading segment, expected to make up 50% of the total market or $24 billion in 2030. This dominance is driven by ongoing improvements in autonomous driving algorithms, machine learning-based perception models, and the growing adoption of real-time simulations and virtual testing environments. Additionally, the integration of over-the-air (OTA) software updates, advanced sensor data processing frameworks for enhanced navigation accuracy, and cybersecurity platforms tailored to autonomous vehicles will further bolster the software market’s growth.

Technological and Application Segments Within the Market The market’s technology landscape includes areas such as computer vision, natural language processing (NLP), machine learning and deep learning, sensor fusion AI, and other emerging AI methods. Regarding applications, AI supports various functionalities like perception, localization and mapping, decision-making and path planning, driver monitoring systems, predictive maintenance, and traffic and navigation assistance. The product lineup also spans multiple vehicle types, including passenger cars, light commercial vehicles (LCVs), and heavy commercial vehicles (HCVs).

Strong Growth Rate Expected Through 2030 The AI in self-driving cars market is projected to grow at a striking compound annual growth rate (CAGR) of 52% leading up to 2030. This robust growth reflects the increasing demand for safer roads, smarter autonomous systems, and more efficient transportation networks worldwide.

Key Drivers Amplifying Market Growth A significant factor propelling this market is the growing demand for enhanced road safety and accident reduction. Governments, fleet operators, and consumers alike are turning to AI-powered autonomous systems as a way to reduce human error behind the wheel. These systems continuously monitor the environment, identify hazards, and assist in safer navigation decisions. The high social and economic costs associated with road accidents are pushing investments toward autonomous mobility solutions, and heightened focus on traffic safety regulations is further boosting market demand. This trend is expected to contribute approximately 1.5% annual growth.

Expansion of Autonomous Mobility and Shared Transportation Services Another vital growth catalyst is the rise of autonomous mobility and shared transportation services. Providers of mobility solutions are increasingly investing in self-driving vehicle fleets to enhance operational efficiency and reduce reliance on human drivers. AI enables these vehicles to operate continuously with optimized route planning and traffic management. As urbanization increases and the demand for convenient transportation options grows, autonomous fleets are becoming more widespread. This expansion is projected to add about 1.0% annual growth to the AI in self-driving cars market.

Government Support and Smart Transportation Initiatives Fueling Progress Supportive government policies and initiatives aimed at smart transportation also play a crucial role in market development. Public funding for autonomous vehicle testing, intelligent transport infrastructure, and connected mobility projects is accelerating deployment efforts. Regulatory frameworks facilitate pilot programs and commercialization of autonomous vehicles, while public sector efforts to improve traffic flow and reduce congestion create favorable market conditions. This support is expected to contribute roughly 0.5% annual growth in the market.

Major Growth Opportunities Across Hardware, Software, and Services Significant opportunities exist within the hardware, software, and services segments, which together are expected to contribute over $43 billion to the market by 2030. This growth is fueled by demand for advanced AI processors, automotive-grade computing platforms, and widespread adoption of LiDAR, radar, and camera-based sensing systems.
